tests on solid E
Complete the expected observations.
Solid E was dissolved in water to form solution E. Solution E was divided into three approximately
equal portions in one boiling tube and two test-tubes.

content.html: Aqueous sodium hydroxide was added to the first portion of solution E in a boiling tube. The mixture formed was warmed. Any gas produced was tested.
